oauthConsent.title: Access request
oauthConsent.intro: The application {clientName} is requesting access to your data in Nestor.
oauthConsent.scopesHeading: What it will be able to do
oauthConsent.scopeBoqRead: Read bills of quantities and measurements for your projects
oauthConsent.unknownClientWarning: We do not recognise this application. Check the address before approving.
oauthConsent.loopbackWarning: It returns to a program on your own computer. Approve only if you just started this connection yourself.
oauthConsent.readOnlyNotice: Access is read-only. No writes or deletions are possible.
oauthConsent.errorExpired: The request expired. Start the connection again from the application.
oauthConsent.errorConsumed: This request has already been answered.
oauthConsent.errorNotFound: No request found. Start the connection again from the application.
oauthConsent.errorWrongUser: The request belongs to a different account.
oauthConsent.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Start the connection again from the application.

denyReason.unknownRole: Your account role is not recognised — contact an administrator
denyReason.unknownAction: Unknown action — permission cannot be evaluated

denyReason.pending: Your brokerage declaration is awaiting approval. Once approved, you will be able to list properties on behalf of clients.
denyReason.revoked: Your organisation’s brokerage capability has been revoked. See the reason in the organisation settings.
denyReason.unrequested: Your organisation has not declared brokerage activity. Only registered real estate agencies may publish listings for third-party properties (Greek Law 4072/2012).

requirement.unknown: A requirement is outstanding that this version of the application does not yet recognise.

capability.title: Brokerage activity
capability.lead: Greek Law 4072/2012 allows intermediation for third-party properties only for registered real estate agencies. Here you declare your registration details and see where your application stands.

headline.unrequested: This organisation has not declared brokerage activity. Fill in your registration details to start the review.
headline.pending: Your declaration has been submitted and is under review. There is nothing further to do — you will be informed once a decision is made.
headline.active: Brokerage activity is approved. You can publish listings for your clients' properties.
headline.revoked: This organisation's brokerage capability has been revoked. The reason for the decision is below, and you may submit a new declaration.

capability.revocationMissing: The decision was recorded without a written reason. Please contact us to be informed of it.
capability.gemiHint: The General Commercial Registry number, as it appears on your registration notice.
capability.chamberHint: Your broker registry number at the relevant Chamber of Commerce.
capability.representativeHint: The person who meets the individual requirements for practising brokerage. For a legal entity, brokerage must be part of the statutory purpose.
capability.legalNote: The declaration does not by itself enable the capability: the details are reviewed before it is approved.
capability.incomplete: Fill in all three registration details.

failure.invalid: The details were not accepted. Check that every field is filled in correctly.
failure.forbidden: You are not allowed to declare brokerage activity for this organisation.
failure.conflict: The organisation's status changed in the meantime. Refresh the page to see where it stands now.
failure.failed: The submission did not complete. Please try again.
